title: Tornado Cash withdrawal to the operator
detail: 0.1 ETH from the Tornado Cash pool to 0x7C86…5CA0; another at 08:53 and a third at 08:23 Oct 29.

title: Second Tornado Cash withdrawal
detail: 0.1 ETH to the operator.

title: Sibling wallet funded
detail: 0xFD41 receives 0.1 ETH from Tornado Cash.

title: Sibling wallet funded
detail: 0xe4F9 receives 0.1 ETH from Tornado Cash.

title: Third Tornado Cash withdrawal
detail: 0.1 ETH to the operator. About 1.49 ETH in total funded the operation.

title: 1 ETH pool withdrawal
detail: 0xe4F9 receives 0.994 ETH from the Tornado Cash 1 ETH pool.

title: Gas for the real run
detail: 0xe4F9 sends the operator 1.082 ETH.

title: Sweeper v1 deployed
detail: The first sweeper contract, 0x19bE…f2bf, never verified on any explorer.

title: Rehearsal one
detail: Two of the operator's own wallets delegated with EIP-7702, seeded with a few dollars of USDT and USDC, and swept.

title: Sweeper v2 deployed
detail: The production contract, 0x63e8…6fAe: operator-only, leaves exactly 1 ETH, with an execute passthrough and a withdraw.

title: Rehearsal two, the full sequence
detail: Delegate, fund with 1.01 ETH, sweep (1 ETH left), withdraw. The exact sequence used on Binance 14.

title: 185,017,485 XRP ($236M) to a new account
detail: XRP Ledger transfer from accounts Whale Alert labels Binance. Binance has not said whether it was its own.

title: 965,455 SOL ($95M) to a new address
detail: Solana transfer from a wallet Whale Alert labels Binance.

title: The delegation
detail: One transaction carries 50 EIP-7702 authorizations, all signed by Binance 14's key. The one matching its live nonce (18914809) applies.

title: The sweep
detail: 167,464 ETH and 63 tokens to 0x5227…2f8c in one call, for about $0.93 in gas. Largest line: 1.615B USDT.

title: 780M USDC through a trusted wallet
detail: Hot Wallet 34 accepts Binance 14 as its owner and releases 780M USDC to 0x5227.

title: 43M USDC more
detail: The same route through Hot Wallet 34.

title: First re-sweep
detail: 3.9M USDT plus dust.

title: Second re-sweep
detail: 200.4M USDT, 6,591 LINK, 7,008 UNI and smaller lines.

title: The long tail
detail: Smaller tokens worth at least $7.5M on the ten lines shown, to a second receiver.

title: Six empty sweeps
detail: The operator calls sweep six more times. Nothing moves.

title: Tether freezes $971M
detail: First reported by @TreeNewsFeed, ten minutes before any Binance account spoke.

title: Circle freezes 823M USDC
detail: Jeremy Allaire confirms more than 800M USDC frozen at 21:18, in coordination with law enforcement (per The Block).

title: Tether raises its freeze to 1.567B USDT
detail: Paolo Ardoino: 'Tether froze more than 1.567B USDT related to a potential Binance exchange hack.'

title: Aave freezes its USDT market
detail: Aave freezes its USDT market, blocking new borrowing against it, per @WatcherGuru.

title: Binance thanks Ripple
detail: Yi He thanks Ripple for freezing 'approximately 200 million' (unit not stated); no freeze shows on the traced XRP account.

title: World Liberty freezes
detail: $27M USD1 and 48M WLFI frozen, per Yi He.

title: CZ: 'It does look like a hack'
detail: 'User funds are safe!' The most-engaged post of the event. @binance posts holding statements at 21:15, 21:16 and 21:24.

title: 'User funds are completely safe'
detail: @binance reposts its statement with one added sentence; it draws ten times the engagement.

title: 'Will cover'
detail: CZ: 'Loss might be a bit higher than that, but will cover.'

title: Some withdrawals processed
detail: Per CryptoTicker, some BTC, ETH and USDT withdrawals were processed; Binance's 22:33 notice said withdrawals would resume once the issue was resolved.

title: Binance Alpha trading paused
detail: Suspended as a security measure.

title: $2.54B verified frozen
detail: Binance addresses 'differing figures circulating publicly'.

title: Binance 14 revokes the delegation
detail: A type-4 transaction pointing the delegation at the zero address clears the attacker's code after 3h 49m.

title: Full pause; will cover all losses
detail: 'As a precaution, all deposits and withdrawals are temporarily suspended.'

title: About $3B verified frozen
detail: 'The current verified total frozen amount is around $3 billion.'

title: First 'hack' post
detail: @spreekaway, 39.5K followers: 'Unconfirmed, but possibly massive binance hack.' 1.6M engagements.

title: Mechanism explained
detail: @odysseas_eth lays out the EIP-7702 sweeper and the 63-token sweep.

title: Full reconstruction
detail: @0xQuit has the deploy time and the four-step sequence right.

title: Rehearsals found
detail: @MetaFinancialAI posts the rehearsal timeline, 67 minutes after the sweep.

title: @WatcherGuru: '$5.6B stolen'
detail: An unconfirmed outflow estimate; reported figures ranged from $2.53B to $5.7B.

title: Musk: 'Everyday is Zeroday'
detail: A quote-post of @KobeissiLetter's $5.7B estimate.

title: BNB evening low, $692.32
detail: From $738.90 at 20:15 (CoinMarketCap via CryptoTicker).

title: BTC low, $78,763
detail: From $80,327 at 20:15. About $628M of leveraged positions closed within the hour (CoinGlass via PANews).
